coverage: 31 unique visible extra-stimulus packets; concealed native adult-card prompts removed with bodies are explicitly pending and not guessed.

packets.heading: Three complete original text models
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Three distinct coherent texts: story has note-loss/problem/help/return resolution; information organises shelf facts and return method; persuasion has polite request and relevant room-access/quiet-reading reason. No single purpose forced by format.

packets.heading: Sentences and word choices
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Simple seed-tray sentence has one clause; noun group contains determiner/adjective/compound noun; was resting is whole verb group. Soil-dry so Mila-water has two independent clauses and valid cause/result. Seeds and soil is noun coordination. Basket/garden/paper are common two-syllable examples in ordinary local speech.

packets.heading: An edit you can explain
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Revision must capitalise Mila, replace thing with seed tray, remove duplicated it and add final full stop; actions carrying tray to garden then shelving remain coherent; it refers clearly to tray.

packets.heading: Create and edit a simple digital text
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Actual digital product should contain matching carrying-before-placing panels and captions; learner must make a meaningful edit/reorder if needed and check resulting text/art. Save with adult assistance. Paper analogue cannot alone certify actual digital creation.

packets.heading: Planning cards to sort and use
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: A maps to imaginative/entertain with coherent hat problem and resolution; B informative with facts grouped by tray location and materials; C persuasive with request/reason/polite trial action. Multiple valid headings/reasons accepted if they fit intended reader/facts.

packets.heading: A fresh written check
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Accept heading such as Our craft tray and short information text retaining craft-tray/door/red-brush-pot/paper-box facts. Require meaningful order and accurate word choice/edit explanation; no unrelated facts. Example: Our craft tray is beside the door. Put clean brushes in the red pot. Put paper scraps in the paper box.

packets.heading: Show what you can create
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Observed texts: a new story linking hat loss/help/recovery/ending, plus separate polite quiet-drawing-corner request supported by a fitting benefit; learner rereads and explains a meaning/sentence edit.

packets.heading: Complete original presentation and useful cue
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Opening identifies reading-box explanation; choose and return directions and purpose/close form coherent short talk. Three-box cue choose/read/return supports actual delivery; printed cue itself does not evidence speaking. Box facts are invented model givens.

packets.heading: Rehearse, listen and improve
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Listener should understand returning book to box with cover facing front. Observe rehearsal, genuine feedback, one purposeful revision and redelivery; evaluate structure, topic words, accessible audibility and pauses rather than assumed universal voice norms.

packets.heading: Two purposes; purposeful delivery
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Welcome inviting visiting class and care reminder can appropriately differ in tone/context. Same words may convey invitation/reminder through delivery/context, but intended effect must be checked against actual listener response. No fixed pitch objectively required.

packets.heading: A different presentation to prepare
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Paper folding explanation should start with purpose/material, sequence flat paper -> short edge to other short edge -> press fold -> open/show inside, then close naming card. A visual/action cue should match sequence. Listener can follow the correct steps; real rehearsal/revision/delivery needed.

packets.heading: A fresh presentation check
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Accept art-tray explanatory talk retaining blue-pot clean pencils, paper scraps in paper box, tray by window; purposeful opening/ordered points/cue/ending, observed rehearsal with specific clarity question and revised actual delivery. Distinct from reading-box model.

packets.heading: A useful reflection
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Reflection must cite actual listener understanding/feedback, a specific change with reason and next attempt target; the written reflection supports but cannot replace delivery evidence.

packets.heading: Prepare a real handwriting model
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Real local taught unjoined model must be present and adult demonstrate actual movements; learner copies beside model without tracing using comfortable preferred-hand/adapted setup. No unique mandatory grip; typed targets not stroke-order proof.

packets.heading: Complete handwriting targets
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Mia capital M contrasts mia lower-case; Sam/bag/paper/garden retain supplied case/order. Sentence copies require correct unjoined actual written forms, recognisability and word spaces. Spelling supplied to reduce unrelated composition load.

packets.heading: Check relative size and placement
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Compare short a body/tall b/descending g/capital B from actual local script; a big bag has three words and two visible word gaps. Descenders may extend below baseline, not entire letters forced above it.

packets.heading: Compare actual attempts over time
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Compare dated similar-condition actual samples; keep readable forms/gaps while ease grows. A short improvement target should be observed and applied, not a universal timed threshold. Record modelling/support/conditions and stop if painful.

packets.heading: A fresh actual handwriting check
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Tom put a bag on the shelf. should be actually written unjoined from nearby adult model, with capital T, recognisable letters, word gaps and sentence ending. Identify one real strength and specific improvement; process/grasp assessed only through observation.

packets.heading: Make one useful next step
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Choose actual writing feature evidenced in sample, compare with actual nearby model, practise in another word and check comfort/readability. Avoid judging typed aesthetics or rushing.

packets.heading: Complete sound-card routine
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Fresh maps f/r/short-e/sh -> four phonemes; cloudy has two syllables/five phonemes k/l/cloud-vowel/d/happy-vowel. Counters/finger taps one per sound; adult hidden-card prompts absent in blind file and remain pending.

packets.heading: Build, improve and explain a word chain
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Slam -> slim substitutes medial vowel; slim -> swim substitutes l with w; each has four phonemes and preserves other positions. Print/encoding only follows oral task. Displayed chain practice cannot show independent hearing manipulation.

packets.heading: Quick-answer checks and fresh oral transfer
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Retained phoneme checks have saved independent criteria. Fresh adult card instruction missing from blind body, so cannot solve hidden operation yet.

packets.heading: Complete reading and sorting cards
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Vowel examples ee green, oo moon/book contrast, ai rain/raincoat, ay play, ea beach/bread contrast, igh night. Clusters frog f/r and crisp k/r (also final s/p); silent initial k in knee, final b in thumb. Compounds raincoat/sunset; rabbit not compound. Multiple memberships valid. Adult/models may support actual reading.

packets.heading: Map, write and reread
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Rain r/ai/n three sounds; thumb th/u/mb three sounds (b not separately pronounced); robot two syllables. Phoneme/grapheme grouping accurately conveys these chosen examples without universal rule. Dictation target/body absent, pending.

packets.heading: Quick-answer checks and transfer
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Bright: b/r/igh/t four phonemes; igh long i. Sunhat = sun + hat, six phonemes in typical speech and two complete words. Actual reading obtained before adult target read; covered writing dictation prompt pending.

packets.heading: Complete word-analysis cards
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Said ai and friend ie encode short-e; come/have final e not making long vowel here. One/once begin /w/ without written w; only/lone contain long o. Compare complete conventional spellings, not false one+ly=only algorithm.

packets.heading: Complete related-word and context tasks
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Jumped ed pronounced t, played ed pronounced d, wanted ed adds syllable; all past time. Helpful/played/jumping valid base+suffix words used in meaningful sentences. Wind-weather short-i versus wind-toy long-i chosen from letters plus contextual meaning.

packets.heading: Quick answers and a covered spelling turn
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Retained quick checks covered in separate criteria. Paint known base; fresh dictation target absent from blind card, cannot infer intended derived word merely from base.

packets.heading: Complete base and affix cards
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Examples help/helper/helpful/helping, kind/unkind/kindness, friend/friendly/friendship, cover/covering/uncover have meaningful shared base. re/un prefix cards go before; er/ful/ing/ed/ness/ly/ship suffix cards after. Conventional combinations only; semantics must be explained.

packets.heading: Family boundary check
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Replay/player have base play; day rhymes without same base. Unkind has base kind; nice is a synonym relationship only, no kind base. Meaning+spelling family distinguished from rhyme and synonymy.

packets.heading: Quick answers and a new family
packets.independent_criteria_or_model_verificati: Pack known base supplied; fresh-family task body is absent, so no unique new target/meaning can be inferred. Retained quick checks already independently recomputed.
